prompt: What coordinate system does Swing use for painting?
choices: Origin at the bottom-left, y increases upward
Origin at the center, axes extend outward
Origin at the top-left corner, x increases right, y increases downward
Origin at the top-right corner, x increases left
explanation: Swing uses a top-left origin where (0,0) is the top-left corner of the component. X increases to the right; Y increases downward. A component with width=200, height=100 has its bottom-right at (199, 99).
